label: Total spend
sql:
WITH priced_usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_quantity, u.sku_name, u.cloud, u.usage_end_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY p.price_start_time DESC) AS price_rank,
         p.pricing.default AS unit_price
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
    ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud
   AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
   AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * unit_price), 2) AS value
FROM priced_usage WHERE price_rank = 1

label: Spend · last 30 days
sql:
WITH priced_usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_quantity,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY p.price_start_time DESC) AS price_rank,
         p.pricing.default AS unit_price
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
    ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud
   AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
   AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) AND CURRENT_DATE()
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(usage_quantity * unit_price), 0), 2) AS value
FROM priced_usage WHERE price_rank = 1

label: Workspace · 24h
sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(usage_quantity), 0), 2) AS value
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
  AND usage_unit = 'DBU'
  AND usage_end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS
  AND usage_end_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()

label: Job health
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED','TIMED_OUT','ERROR','INTERNAL_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
  AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(period_start_time) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) AND CURRENT_DATE()

label: Total DBU
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 2) AS value
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
  AND usage_unit = 'DBU'
  AND usage_date BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Spend by compute type
sql:
WITH priced_usage AS (
  SELECT u.billing_origin_product, u.usage_quantity, p.pricing.default AS unit_price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY p.price_start_time DESC) AS price_rank
  FROM system.billing.usage u JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
    ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud
   AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
   AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'
)
SELECT billing_origin_product, ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * unit_price), 2) AS value
FROM priced_usage WHERE price_rank = 1
GROUP BY billing_origin_product ORDER BY value DESC

label: Total job runs
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(period_start_time) BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Failure rate
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED','TIMED_OUT','ERROR','INTERNAL_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(period_start_time) BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Total runtime
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(period_end_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(period_start_time)) / 3600.0, 2) AS value
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(period_start_time) BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Active jobs
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT job_id) AS value
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND period_end_time IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(period_start_time) BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: SQL dashboard metrics
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_queries, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN total_duration_ms > 30000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS slow_pct, ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS query_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT executed_by) AS distinct_users
FROM system.query.history
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND DATE(start_time) BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Lineage edges
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('|', source_table_full_name, target_table_full_name)) AS value
FROM system.access.table_lineage
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'

label: Audit events
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email) AS users
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND DATE(event_time) BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Notebook DBU cost basis
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 2) AS value
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND usage_unit = 'DBU'
  AND usage_date BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'

label: Spend over time
sql:
WITH priced_usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_date, u.workspace_id, u.billing_origin_product, u.custom_tags,
         u.identity_metadata, u.usage_quantity, p.pricing.default AS unit_price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY p.price_start_time DESC) AS price_rank
  FROM system.billing.usage u JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
    ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud
   AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
   AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}'
    AND u.usage_date BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'
)
SELECT CAST(usage_date AS STRING) AS usage_date, ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * unit_price), 2) AS value
FROM priced_usage WHERE price_rank = 1
GROUP BY usage_date ORDER BY usage_date

label: DBU consumption over time
sql:
SELECT CAST(usage_date AS STRING) AS usage_date, ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 2) AS value
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE workspace_id = '{{workspaceId}}' AND usage_unit = 'DBU'
  AND usage_date BETWEEN '{{startDate}}' AND '{{endDate}}'
GROUP BY usage_date ORDER BY usage_date

sql:
WITH priced_usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_date, u.workspace_id, u.billing_origin_product, u.custom_tags,
         u.identity_metadata, u.usage_quantity, p.pricing.default AS unit_price,

sql:
WITH priced_usage AS (

         u.identity_metadata, u.usage_quantity, p.pricing.default AS unit_price,
